description: Land Title Settle Department - Kandawala, Rathmalana D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 521001 (16/0692 - Rathmalana)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances) in Kandawala village, Colombo District. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlement, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
